latest.module: M3 core glossary and M4 auxiliary vocabulary semantic and interaction contracts
latest.scope: Checks all original twenty vocabulary entries and 100 stem relationships, plus five auxiliary entries (25 total), safe escaping and isolated sheet routing. Actual browser focus/close state is covered by the separate UI regression. Tibetan wording remains subject to native-language review.

results.name: Original twenty M3 entries remain, with exactly five auxiliary M4 entries added
All twenty-five entries have English/Chinese/Traditional/Tibetan title and copy slots
Definition semantics match all 100 official day-master/target-stem relationships
Core definitions distinguish reference, hidden-stem multiplicity and unweighted elements
Potentially misleading stage and void names have explicit calculation boundaries
Plain-text labels, unknown names and attribute hints are escaped safely
Ten Gods renderer handles scalar/array/day-master without adding extra text to cells
Ten Gods overview gives all ten definitions through details without nested sheets
The existing sheet close API is reused and unknown entries do not open it
Glossary click routing is independent of chart navigation and does not call render
Five auxiliary definitions distinguish formulas from conception, health and annual pillars
Each auxiliary term opens the existing sheet with escaped caller text in all four languages
